title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: A vulnerability was identified in TOTOLINK A800R 4.1.2cu.5137_B20200730. This impacts the...
description: A vulnerability was identified in TOTOLINK A800R 4.1.2cu.5137_B20200730. This impacts the function setUrlFilterRules of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component firewall.so. title: LimeSurvey Community Edition 7.0.5 contains an authenticated reflected cross-site scripting...

title: A vulnerability was found in TOTOLINK A800R 4.1.2cu.5137_B20200730. The impacted element is the...
description: A vulnerability was found in TOTOLINK A800R 4.1.2cu.5137_B20200730. The impacted element is the function setRadvdCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component ipv6.so. title: A flaw has been found in TRENDNET TEW-813DRU 1.01b01. Impacted is an unknown function of the file...
description: A flaw has been found in TRENDNET TEW-813DRU 1.01b01. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /etc/vsftpd.conf of the component vsftpd. This manipulation causes incorrect default permissions. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is considered difficult. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.
